title: RetroArch PS5
description: Multi-system emulator frontend with RetroArch and EmulationStation. Requires a compatible PS5 homebrew setup; developer recommends ShadowMountPlus 1.7beta4 or newer.
install_note: Extract the release and install the complete PPSA99169 title folder. ShadowMountPlus 1.7beta4 or later recommended.

title: Castation (Dreamcast)
description: Dreamcast emulator (Homebrew Launcher build). The official ZIP contains Castation/eboot.elf, not an installable PS5 title; manually extract to /data/homebrew/ and launch through Homebrew Launcher. No ROMs included.
install_note: Download the developer ZIP, extract the Castation folder into /data/homebrew/, then run Castation in Homebrew Launcher. Do not use PS5 Library's normal installer for this ELF-based app.

title: Porpoise (GameCube / Wii)
description: Native Dolphin-based GameCube and Wii emulator. Requires a jailbroken console and ShadowMountPlus 1.7beta4 or later. Games not included.
install_note: Install the PPSA99764 title folder, then follow the project setup guide. Requires a working homebrew environment and your own game backups.

title: PS5SX2 (PlayStation 2)
description:
PS5SX2 2.10 — PlayStation 2 emulator (PCSX2).

MANUAL INSTALL — ZIP contains TWO folders:
1. PPSA99203/ → /data/homebrew/PPSA99203/
2. PCSX2/ → /data/PCSX2/ (keep existing saves)

BEFORE YOU PLAY
• Load kstuff → ShadowMount+ → ONE PS5SX2 helper ELF.
• Put your own PS2 BIOS in /data/PCSX2/bios/.
• Put game backups in /data/PCSX2/games/.

IF IT WON'T START
• CE-107750-0? Check folder and eboot.bin permissions (755).
• Remove PS2 discs before shutting down.
install_note: PS5 Library can download this ZIP, but it does not guarantee correct placement of BOTH top-level folders. Manually extract PPSA99203/ into /data/homebrew/PPSA99203/ and PCSX2/ into /data/PCSX2/; do not nest the folders or overwrite existing PCSX2 save data. BIOS: /data/PCSX2/bios/ (your own legally dumped PS2 BIOS). Games: /data/PCSX2/games/. At each boot: jailbreak/kstuff -> ShadowMount+ -> ONE PS5SX2 helper (standard PS5SXHelper.elf default; no-data-mount variant needs ShadowMount+ 1.7-beta5fix1+). Restart before swapping helpers, never load both. CE-107750-0: check PPSA99203 folder and eboot.bin permissions (755 often works). Remove PS2 DVDs before PS5 shutdown.
install_type: Manual install: two folders + helper ELF

title: PS5SX3 (PlayStation 3)
description:
PS5SX3 v7.1 — experimental PlayStation 3 emulator (RPCS3).

INSTALL — .7z archive:
1. PPSA99303/ → /data/homebrew/PPSA99303/
2. Check eboot.bin and sce_sys/ are directly inside.

BEFORE YOU PLAY
• Load jailbreak/kstuff → ShadowMount+ → PS5SXHelper-no-data-mount.elf.
• ShadowMount+ must provide /data; this helper does not mount it.
• PS3 firmware: get PS3UPDAT.PUP from Sony; never use PS5 system update.

IF IT WON'T START
• CE-107750-0? Set title folder and eboot.bin permissions to 755.
• Check there is no extra nested PPSA99303/ folder.

NOTE: v7.1 release mentions a PS3 update file; redistribution rights unverified. Title ID PPSA99303 may be shared with other homebrew.
install_note: Extract the full PPSA99303/ directory from PPSA99303.7z to /data/homebrew/PPSA99303/ (not a nested duplicate). Confirm /data/homebrew/PPSA99303/eboot.bin and sce_sys/ exist. Set title folder and eboot.bin executable/traverse permissions to 755 if launch fails with CE-107750-0; ensure parent/subfolders are accessible. Load jailbreak and kstuff, then compatible ShadowMount+ (responsible for mounting /data), then PS5SXHelper-no-data-mount.elf from Payload Manager. Do not load both helper variants in one session. Sony PS3 firmware is PS3UPDAT.PUP; obtain it from Sony for personal use, never install it via the PS5's system update, and don't redistribute it without permission. v7.1 release notes mention a bundled PS3 update file; contents/licensing and developer provenance are unverified. This title ID PPSA99303 may conflict with other homebrew; verify the correct tile before launching.

title: PS5X360 (Xbox 360)
description: Experimental Xbox 360 emulator. Follow developer firmware, compatibility and setup notes. Games and keys are not included.
install_note: Extract PPSA50011 into /data/homebrew/PPSA50011. Experimental; check the project compatibility guide.

title: XPSemu (Original Xbox)
description: Experimental original Xbox emulator. ALSO requires helper.elf loaded separately with kstuff and your own hardware-dumped Xbox BIOS and MCPX ROM.
install_note: Install PPSA97358 and separately load the matching helper.elf using kstuff. Add your own BIOS and MCPX dumps.

title: PICO-8 PS5
description: PICO-8 launcher for PS5. Requires a separately purchased/licensed Linux PICO-8 copy; the commercial PICO-8 binaries are not included.
install_note: Install PPSA99808, then add your licensed pico8_dyn and pico8.dat files to the application folder.

title: Ruffle Flash PS5
description: Flash / SWF emulator. ALSO requires separately loading the upstream helper.elf with kstuff. SWF content is not included.
install_note: Install PPSA68091 and separately load the matching helper.elf with kstuff. Put your SWF files in /data/ruffle/games/.
